title: ExtrasReport
description: Flat list of declarations. Trust and enable settings are not evaluated.

entries.description: Declarations in stable harness, scope, path, kind, and name order.

ExtraEntry.description: One declaration, or one file that could not be read.

project.description: Project root for a project declaration.

name.description: Event, server, or instruction filename. Absent on unreadable files.

count.description: Handler count for hooks. One for other declarations, zero for unreadable files.

status.description: `found` or `unreadable`. Parser errors are never exposed.
